articles.summary: BATON ROUGE, La., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lamar Advertising Company (Nasdaq: LAMR) will release its third quarter ended September 30, 2026 earnings report before the market opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Lamar will host a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 8:00 a.m.
articles.title: Lamar Advertising Company to Release Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026 Operating Results
